injuries.name: Michael McCarron
injuries.note: Russo relayed that McCarron was upended three times on one shift in the third period, which ultimately forced the forward out of the game. Nick Foligno (upper body) and Marcus Foligno (lower body) are also questionable for Saturday's game, so the Wild have several moving parts for the second half of their back-to-back. McCarron has been centering the second line of late, so Danila Yurov and Ryan Hartman should receive increased responsibilities if McCarron is unavailable Saturday.

injuries.name: Nick Foligno
injuries.note: Foligno has been sidelined for the Wild's last 14 games and will be out for at least one more when the team squares off with San Jose on Friday. In the 39-year-old winger's three games, he generated one goal, three shots and a plus-two rating while averaging just 9:57 of ice time.

injuries.name: Marcus Foligno
injuries.note: The Wild announced Thursday that Foligno would join the team for its upcoming three-game road trip, but he could ultimately return to game action for the final matchup in Minnesota's homestand. The 35-year-old has been sidelined since Oct. 10, and he was held scoreless with 13 hits while averaging 12:10 of ice time across his four appearances prior to his absence.

injuries.name: Filip Gustavsson
injuries.note: Gustavsson has been sidelined since the start of the campaign due to the hip procedure he underwent in the offseason. His inclusion for the team's upcoming road trip is a sign that he hasn't had any major setbacks since being ruled out for at least another month in mid-October. His status will be monitored closely, and once he's able to return, he'll likely see somewhat frequent appearances in net, but he'll be behind Jesper Wallstedt on the depth chart.

injuries.name: Jared Spurgeon
injuries.note: Spurgeon has missed seven of the Wild's last 11 games due to injury, and will likely be out of action for at least two more due to his lower-body problem. During those four appearances, the veteran blueliner failed to register a point while producing six shots, five blocks and three hits.

injuries.name: Brock Faber
injuries.note: Faber's return to practice, after having been limited to solo skates previously, doesn't guarantee he will be in the lineup to face San Jose on Friday, but it's certainly a step in the right direction for the blueliner. Whenever the 24-year-old Minnesota native is given the all-clear, he should be back on the Wild's top pairing in addition to linking up with the No. 1 power-play unit.

injuries.name: Yanni Gourde
injuries.note: Tampa Bay's road trip includes stops in Minnesota, Winnipeg, Buffalo and Columbus on Saturday, Sunday, Wednesday and Thursday, respectively. Gourde hasn't played yet this campaign due to the injury. He had nine goals and 28 points in 82 regular-season appearances with Tampa Bay in 2025-26. Gourde will probably serve in a middle-six role once he's healthy.
